cash_receipt.title: Cash Receipt

cash_receipt.shipping_fee_tax_help: Proportional splits the shipping fee by the taxable and tax-free product amounts.
cash_receipt.self_issue_help: Automatically issues receipts for bank transfer orders even when the buyer did not request one (income deduction only).

requestable.title: Request Conditions
requestable.description: Choose the item statuses and period in which customers may request an exchange, return, cancellation or refund.
requestable.exchange_hint: Only items in these statuses show the exchange request button and can be submitted.
requestable.return_hint: Only items in these statuses show the return request button and can be submitted.
requestable.instant_cancel_hint: Items in these statuses still create a refund request, which is then advanced through approval and completion automatically. Bank-transfer refunds stop at approval and an operator completes them after sending the money.
requestable.refund_request_hint: Items in these statuses are filed as a refund request and refunded after admin approval.
requestable.request_period_days_hint: Exchanges and returns can no longer be requested once this period passes after delivery (or purchase confirmation).

charge.title: Additional Payment

charge.methods_hint: Charge methods customers may pick on the request form. Methods removed here are not offered.
charge.payment_methods_hint: Payment methods usable for claim charges. Points are available to members only.

auto_approve.title: Auto Approval
auto_approve.description: Choose when requests are approved without an administrator review.
auto_approve.zero_charge_hint: Approve exchange and return requests with no additional charge as soon as they are filed.
auto_approve.after_payment_hint: Move the request to approved once the customer completes the additional payment.
auto_approve.refund_request_hint: Move filed refund requests to approved automatically. Executing the refund stays a separate step.
auto_approve.refund_statuses_hint: When auto-approval is on, choose which item statuses are approved automatically. If any item on a request falls outside the list, an operator approves the whole request.
auto_approve.refund_payment_methods_label: Payment methods eligible for automatic refunds
auto_approve.refund_payment_methods_hint: Only refunds paid with the methods selected here proceed automatically. Methods left out (bank transfer, virtual account, and the like) stop at the requested state even for paid items — an operator approves the request and then completes the transfer with [Refund]. This list applies regardless of the auto-approval toggles.

privacy_retention.notice_desc: Under the Act on the Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce, records of contracts, withdrawals, payments and supply of goods must be kept for 5 years, so the retention period cannot be shorter than 5 years. Announce the retention period and erasure method in your privacy policy before turning this on.
privacy_retention.title: Closed order personal information retention
privacy_retention.description: Automatically processes, every day, the orderer and recipient information of orders closed by purchase confirmation or cancellation (with no refund, exchange or return in progress) once the retention period has passed. Orders in delivery or not yet confirmed are never processed.
privacy_retention.enabled_hint: When on, the core privacy retention job (runs daily) processes orders with the method below. Processed data cannot be restored.
privacy_retention.retention_years_hint: Counted from when the order was closed. At least 5 years (e-commerce law).

modes.anonymize: Anonymize (keep the order, mask personal information)

privacy_retention.anonymize_notice: Order number, amounts and product records remain, and the orderer and recipient name, contact number and address are masked. Refund account holders and numbers, reason details and admin memos on exchange, return and refund requests, and exchange redelivery addresses are masked as well. Processed orders can no longer be found through guest order lookup or the admin order search by name or contact number, but can still be opened by order number.
privacy_retention.delete_warning: Deletion cannot be undone. The order is deleted together with its payment, shipping, cancellation, refund, exchange and return records, including attached photos, and product reviews written for it disappear with their images, which changes product ratings. Receipt and transaction lookups on the payment provider screens no longer open for that order number, and coupon issues and mileage history remain but lose their link to the order.
privacy_retention.preview_hint: Target counts are based on the saved settings. If you changed a value, save first and check again.

targets.row_label: Closed orders past the retention period
targets.title: Orders due for retention processing

manual_run.disabled_notice: Automatic runs are off. A manual run ignores the toggle and processes once with the saved settings.
manual_run.irreversible: This cannot be undone. Check the count and the target list before running.
manual_run.queue_hint: A queue worker must be running. You cannot run the same target again until its queued job finishes.
manual_run.queued_toast: The run has been queued. The result will appear when it finishes.
